mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_logs ( event_type, user_id, product_id, search_keyword, page_url, error_message, created_at ) VALUES ( #{eventType}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{searchKeyword}, #{pageUrl}, #{errorMessage}, DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR) )

INSERT INTO search_keyword_statistics ( search_keyword, statistic_hour, event_count ) VALUES ( #{searchKeyword}, DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR), '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'), 1 )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_count = event_count + 1

INSERT INTO page_view_statistics ( page_url, statistic_date, event_count ) VALUES ( #{pageUrl}, DATE(DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR)), 1 )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_count = event_count + 1
